notes: Bloomberg L.P. is privately held (majority-owned by Michael Bloomberg) and files no 10-K, so there is no audited revenue, segment data or Item 1A risk-factor list; all revenue fields are null by design. Source scanned: _ingest/raw/bloomberg/articles.jsonl (850 Bloomberg press releases, stories and insights, 2019-2026). In that corpus Bloomberg discloses no company revenue figure for any year and no current Terminal subscription count (only the 'over 350,000 Terminal users' reach figure from Dec 2023, which counts users rather than paid subscriptions). The only headcount figure is 'more than 12,000 employees' (2018, from a 2019 volunteering release). Revenue-line names above are the business lines Bloomberg describes in its own materials, listed for cross-company mapping only. Third-party revenue estimates (e.g. Burton-Taylor, press reports) deliberately excluded per audit rules; 'Bloomberg Philanthropies' figures in the corpus relate to a separate entity and were ignored.
